composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Paint Ran Mouri with her recognizable long dark hair and distinctive lifted front section, wearing a modest ivory cardigan over a blue collared shirt. Her torso turns slightly, while her face remains almost frontal and both eyes stay clear. One hand rests lightly on the cardigan front below the collarbone. Use opaque gouache in peach, cream, and muted blue, with broad hair masses and a few defined edges around the cheeks. Keep her natural teenage appearance and an easy closed-mouth smile. The background is spacious and quiet, without a full room or decorative lettering. Inside both visible irises, place a red Mangekyo-inspired design using an original simple rotating black petal pattern, a clear pupil, and bright catchlights; the marks stay entirely inside the irises. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for recognizable character, readable requested eye motif, appealing expression, original nonviolent composition, coherent anatomy, no text or watermark
